Treatment costs start at $18,995 for standard multi-week programs. Total costs vary based on protocol duration, specific therapies required, and diagnostic needs.
Can alternative cancer treatment be combined with conventional cancer treatment?
Yes, many patients utilize integrative therapies alongside conventional treatments. Any combination should be coordinated with qualified physicians to evaluate safety and compatibility.
What risks should patients consider before choosing alternative cancer treatment?
Patients should consider potential side effects, detox responses, treatment limitations, and personal health conditions before starting therapy.

International patients submit medical records for review, receive a treatment plan and quote, and coordinate travel with ITC's support team.

Patients should provide recent pathology reports, imaging scans (CT, MRI, PET), blood work, diagnosis summaries, and a history of previous treatments.

It has good food, cool places to visit, and fun activities to enjoy while you are getting better. Let’s look at some of the best things to do in Tijuana and how you can get there easily.

Getting to Tijuana Made Easy
By Plane
San Diego International Airport (SAN) is just 25 minutes from Tijuana. Many people from the U.S., Canada, and other countries like this option. ITC even offers free rides to and from the airport.
By Plane
Tijuana also has its own airport, Tijuana International Airport (TIJ), with flights from many big U.S. cities. It’s a great choice for anyone coming for cancer treatment.
By Bus or Car
You can drive or take a bus to Tijuana if you’re in Mexico or the U.S. Highways connect Tijuana to big cities like San Diego, making it easy to get here by road.
By Train
If you’re in Southern California, trains like Amtrak’s Pacific Surfliner and the San Diego Trolley are good options. They’re a fun, green way to enjoy the trip to Tijuana.
